name: Language Selector
description: One-click language selection for anime and media playback with AniWorld-style flag buttons
overview: Adds flag buttons to episode pages for instant playback with selected audio/subtitle combinations. Perfect for anime fans who want quick access to German audio, Japanese audio with German subs, or English subs.

versions.changelog:
Reliability fixes
- Flag images are now served anonymously with the correct image/svg+xml MIME type via the plugin's own endpoint (previously they could fail to render)
- Clicking a flag reliably starts playback in that language via the Sessions API (the same mechanism as Jellyfin's Play On feature)
- Stale script tags from older plugin versions are now cleaned out of index.html on startup

Major fixes
- Flags now actually appear: the client script is served as application/javascript via a dedicated controller (the old configurationpage URL returned text/html, which browsers refused to execute)
- Settings are saved/loaded correctly (config page now uses the pageshow event)
- On movies and episodes you can click a flag to start playback in that language
- Library scan always has a schedule (configurable interval, default 24h)
- Script injection moved into the plugin entry point (proven JellyScrub-style approach) with base-path support

Language availability flags & reliability
- Show language flags on movies, episodes and single videos (not just series)
- Detect the web client's #/details?id= route so detail pages are recognised
- Inject the client script into the web client so the flag buttons actually appear
- Library scan now really enumerates and analyzes media, honouring the selected libraries
- Only show flags that have a matching asset (no misleading default flag)
- Respect the AutoDetectLanguages and PreferredLanguages settings
- Added unit tests

Library Scanning Update
- Added automatic library scanning for language options
- Scheduled task with configurable intervals
- Scan on server startup option
- Manual scan trigger in plugin settings
- Enhanced configuration page with scan settings

Feature update
- Added read-only language indicators on episode list views
- Added language display on Series/Season detail pages
- Shows available audio/subtitle combinations across entire series

Initial release
- One-click language selection with flag buttons
- Support for German, Japanese, and English audio/subtitles
- AniWorld-inspired UI design
- Automatic language detection from media streams
- REST API endpoint for language options
